details: Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana experienced declines on July 16, with the total crypto market cap falling 1.3%, as increased tensions in the Middle East prompted a broader risk-off sentiment across cryptocurrencies and tech stocks. Despite the market pullback, Morgan Stanley's E*TRADE officially launched spot cryptocurrency trading for Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana, indicating growing institutional adoption. Spot Bitcoin ETFs also saw positive inflows of $107 million, and institutional investors channeled $45 million into Ethereum ETFs yesterday.
title: Bitcoin Pulls Back Amid Geopolitical Tensions; E*TRADE Launches Spot Crypto Trading

details: The overall cryptocurrency market continued its decline on July 17, with Bitcoin down approximately 1.01% and Ethereum falling around 2.39% over 24 hours, leading to a 1.6% drop in the total crypto market capitalization. The widely-tracked crypto Fear and Greed Index registered a score of 27, firmly in "Fear" territory, a slight increase from 25 the previous day. Analysts attribute the subdued sentiment to inconsistent ETF flows and ongoing macroeconomic uncertainties.
title: Crypto Market Declines as Fear & Greed Index Remains in "Fear"

details: Bitcoin and other major cryptocurrencies saw a drop on July 17 following the release of Kimi K3, a free, open-weight AI coding model from China's Moonshot AI, which outperformed leading U.S. AI models like Anthropic's Claude and OpenAI's GPT. This development challenged the perception of advanced AI scarcity and U.S. dominance, triggering a sell-off in AI and semiconductor stocks, which in turn impacted crypto valuations closely tied to AI infrastructure sentiment.
title: Chinese AI Model Outperforms, Contributing to Bitcoin's Decline

details: Binance, a leading cryptocurrency exchange, has evolved significantly, now serving over 316 million users as an integrated financial platform. This evolution extends beyond its initial role as a spot trading venue to include payments, savings, tokenized securities, and access to traditional assets. A recent CoinDesk Research study cited by TNW emphasizes that this transformation highlights the broader maturation of centralized exchanges, with a strong focus on compliance and robust risk management.
title: Binance Transforms into Financial Super App, Highlighting Industry Maturation

details: In a significant move for mainstream adoption, Visa introduced its VSP stablecoin platform, designed to provide stablecoin services for over 200 million merchants. This enterprise-grade platform enables banks to integrate stablecoin payment capabilities, supporting major assets like USDC and USDG, and aims to cover approximately 15,000 financial institutions. Additionally, Tether invested $20 million in Ualá, an Argentine digital bank, further expanding stablecoin presence in Latin America.
title: Visa Launches Stablecoin Platform, Boosting Mainstream Adoption

details: Bloomberg Senior ETF Analyst Eric Balchunas suggests that Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) may follow a pattern similar to gold ETFs, characterized by rapid booms followed by declines and prolonged periods of stagnation before reaching higher eventual peaks. This cautionary outlook comes as BlackRock's digital-asset assets under management (AUM) reportedly fell by about 40% year-on-year in Q2, despite some recent net inflows into U.S. spot crypto ETFs.
title: Bloomberg Analyst Warns Bitcoin ETFs Could Mirror Gold's Boom-Bust Cycle
